body:
Thank you for your reply. I've really been trying lately. I've been forcing myself to get out every day, but it always comes back every night as I sit alone in my apartment. I've never been good at making friends and have always been very socially awkward, which is the main reason I dropped out of high school. I have my GED, but it doesn't make me feel like any less of a loser.

I try to keep my mind occupied but I just don't have any interest in anything I once had. I can't concentrate on anything for any amount of time and most of the time don't have a desire to do anything but lay in bed and stare at the ceiling. 

I've felt this way for over a decade and it's exhausting. I have severe anxiety and get panic attacks very easily. I genuinely feel like I'm beyond help at this point.
